clock: one simulation step equals one day

pilot.primary_estimand: paired difference-in-differences: (1.00-0.70 cooling benefit at early delay) minus the same benefit at late delay

interpretation_boundaries: response_heat_multiplier 1.00 still publishes a response and is not a no-response control
response_heat_multiplier 0.70 identifies only the forced heat-cooling component under this model
pilot confidence intervals quantify Monte Carlo variation across seeds, not population sampling uncertainty
the external hotspot-demand adapter is observational and does not alter the pilot mechanism
